c10_station.relay.lead.01.speaker: frank
c10_station.relay.lead.01.text: The club sent signal three yesterday, without me. Today I’m sending signal four. Let’s see who keeps up.
c10_station.relay.lead.01.synthesis_text: The club sent signal three yesterday, without me. Today I’m sending signal four. Let’s see who keeps up.
c10_station.relay.lead.01.previous_text: K7BLW calling the Thursday club. We’re going to need a few more operators.
c10_station.relay.lead.01.next_text: The official channel just sent back three. That’s yesterday’s cue.

c2_ship.command.lead.06.speaker: guard
c2_ship.command.lead.06.text: Thank you, escorts. It is nearly dawn, and the town will expect you at breakfast.
c2_ship.command.lead.06.synthesis_text: Thank you, escorts. It is nearly dawn, and the town will expect you at breakfast.
c2_ship.command.lead.06.direction: to Nora’s copy and the deputy, sending them back up the tunnel
c2_ship.command.lead.06.previous_text: Dad’s counter ticks once a second. The lamp lit at tick three. The buckle clicked at tick seven.

c2_ship.escape.03.speaker: guard
c2_ship.escape.03.text: Prefect? I did not ask for a release. The scan is not finished.
c2_ship.escape.03.synthesis_text: Prefect? I did not ask for a release. The scan is not finished.
c2_ship.escape.03.direction: startled, turning away from the chair to the speaker column
c2_ship.escape.03.next_text: Prefect, please repeat your instruction. The chair says you released it.

c2_ship.escape.04.speaker: guard
c2_ship.escape.04.text: Prefect, please repeat your instruction. The chair says you released it.
c2_ship.escape.04.synthesis_text: Prefect, please repeat your instruction. The chair says you released it.
c2_ship.escape.04.direction: at the speaker column, back to the chair
c2_ship.escape.04.previous_text: Prefect? I did not ask for a release. The scan is not finished.
c2_ship.escape.04.next_text: It worked. Sixty-one percent of me, and all of me is getting out of this chair.

c2_ship.escape.05.speaker: steve
c2_ship.escape.05.text: The attendant is busy arguing with the column. Quietly, now.
c2_ship.escape.05.synthesis_text: [whispers] The attendant is busy arguing with the column. Quietly, now.
c2_ship.escape.05.previous_text: It worked. Sixty-one percent of me, and all of me is getting out of this chair.
c2_ship.escape.05.next_text: The Prefect’s own voice opened the chair, at the notch marked sixty-one. The scan stopped at sixty-one percent.

c2_ship.intake.02.speaker: guard
c2_ship.intake.02.text: Something is in the water! Something big!
c2_ship.intake.02.synthesis_text: Something is in the water! Something big!
c2_ship.intake.02.previous_text: Come on, Admiral. You never missed this one.
c2_ship.intake.02.next_text: Nora’s real whistle, through the speakers I fixed the day we met. Admiral came down through the dark and dragged me to the surface.

c2_ship.intake.lead.01.speaker: saren
c2_ship.intake.lead.01.text: I gave no release. Look at the chair.
c2_ship.intake.lead.01.synthesis_text: I gave no release. Look at the chair.
c2_ship.intake.lead.01.previous_text: Nora is alive. Her breath keeps its own time, a little behind the ship’s. She’s asleep, not gone.
c2_ship.intake.lead.01.next_text: The chair is empty! Prefect, the human is gone!

c2_ship.intake.lead.02.speaker: guard
c2_ship.intake.lead.02.text: The chair is empty! Prefect, the human is gone!
c2_ship.intake.lead.02.synthesis_text: The chair is empty! Prefect, the human is gone!
c2_ship.intake.lead.02.direction: whirling round from the speaker column
c2_ship.intake.lead.02.previous_text: I gave no release. Look at the chair.
c2_ship.intake.lead.02.next_text: The brass hatch in the floor. That’s the intake valve. Flood the tunnel, and they’ll have to swim after me.

c2_ship.intake.lead.03.speaker: steve
c2_ship.intake.lead.03.text: The brass hatch in the floor. That’s the intake valve. Flood the tunnel, and they’ll have to swim after me.
c2_ship.intake.lead.03.synthesis_text: [whispers] The brass hatch in the floor. That’s the intake valve. Flood the tunnel, and they’ll have to swim after me.
c2_ship.intake.lead.03.direction: a whisper, hauling the valve wheel
c2_ship.intake.lead.03.previous_text: The chair is empty! Prefect, the human is gone!
c2_ship.intake.lead.03.next_text: Water in the intake! The human is in the tunnel!

c2_ship.intake.lead.04.speaker: guard
c2_ship.intake.lead.04.text: Water in the intake! The human is in the tunnel!
c2_ship.intake.lead.04.synthesis_text: Water in the intake! The human is in the tunnel!
c2_ship.intake.lead.04.previous_text: The brass hatch in the floor. That’s the intake valve. Flood the tunnel, and they’ll have to swim after me.
c2_ship.intake.lead.04.next_text: The tunnel’s flooding. The underwater speakers still work... I fixed them, the day I met her.

c2_ship.intake.lead.05.speaker: steve
c2_ship.intake.lead.05.text: Admiral swims the whole bay at night. If he hears the right whistle, he’ll come.
c2_ship.intake.lead.05.synthesis_text: Admiral swims the whole bay at night. If he hears the right whistle, he’ll come.
c2_ship.intake.lead.05.previous_text: The tunnel’s flooding. The underwater speakers still work... I fixed them, the day I met her.
c2_ship.intake.lead.05.next_text: Please stop! You are not finished!

c2_ship.intake.lead.06.speaker: guard
c2_ship.intake.lead.06.text: Please stop! You are not finished!
c2_ship.intake.lead.06.synthesis_text: Please stop! You are not finished!
c2_ship.intake.lead.06.direction: wading into the tunnel after him
c2_ship.intake.lead.06.previous_text: Admiral swims the whole bay at night. If he hears the right whistle, he’ll come.
c2_ship.intake.lead.06.next_text: Nora’s spool, the loose copy, or the Prefect. One chance.

c2_ship.intake.lead.07.speaker: steve
c2_ship.intake.lead.07.text: Nora’s spool, the loose copy, or the Prefect. One chance.
c2_ship.intake.lead.07.synthesis_text: Nora’s spool, the loose copy, or the Prefect. One chance.
c2_ship.intake.lead.07.previous_text: Please stop! You are not finished!
c2_ship.intake.lead.07.next_text: Come on, Admiral. You never missed this one.

c2_ship.recap.03.speaker: steve
c2_ship.recap.03.text: And the woman with Nora’s face, who locked me out on the balcony and then let me go, had walked me to that chair herself.
c2_ship.recap.03.synthesis_text: And the woman with Nora’s face, who locked me out on the balcony and then let me go, had walked me to that chair herself.
c2_ship.recap.03.previous_text: They tried to make another me. They got sixty-one percent.
c2_ship.recap.03.next_text: Sheriff... there’s a ship. Under the bay.

c3_archive.out.11.speaker: calder
c3_archive.out.11.text: I’m calling Adrian Rook. FBI. He owes me a favor from a kidnapping case twenty years ago.
c3_archive.out.11.synthesis_text: I’m calling Adrian Rook. FBI. He owes me a favor from a kidnapping case twenty years ago.
c3_archive.out.11.previous_text: She isn’t on anyone’s. Ninety-one years old, on a boathouse step at midnight. Counting.

c4_escape.out.02.speaker: steve
c4_escape.out.02.text: Kidnapping Nora. And they’ll scan June tonight, because she stayed behind for me. I can’t get back up that hill alone. I have to keep moving.
c4_escape.out.02.synthesis_text: Kidnapping Nora. And they’ll scan June tonight, because she stayed behind for me. I can’t get back up that hill alone. I have to keep moving.
c4_escape.out.02.previous_text: All units. Steve Mercer, wanted for the abduction of Nora Reyes. And scan Calder tonight. The signing is in six days.
c4_escape.out.02.next_text: Roadblocks on the coast road and both bridges. Dogs at first light. He’ll head for town.

c4_safe.in.07.speaker: steve
c4_safe.in.07.text: He took every tape I’d brought, even Mom’s voicemail. An hour later he handed that one back. Not evidence, he said.
c4_safe.in.07.synthesis_text: He took every tape I’d brought, even Mom’s voicemail. An hour later he handed that one back. Not evidence, he said.
c4_safe.in.07.next_text: Every hour, on the hour, Rook goes on hold with the Bureau. And he hums along.

c4_safe.match.02.speaker: calder
c4_safe.match.02.text: Not here, Mercer. Not with Adrian’s agents in the hall.
c4_safe.match.02.synthesis_text: Not here, Mercer. Not with Adrian’s agents in the hall.
c4_safe.match.02.previous_text: Different rooms. Same breath, same pause, same little click on the S. That isn’t a man repeating himself. That’s a recording wearing a man.
c4_safe.match.02.next_text: June’s voicemail and Rook’s voice through the door are one recording, breath for breath, like Nora’s good morning. The man running this house isn’t Adrian Rook.

c7_gate.talk.stephen.3.02.speaker: stephen
c7_gate.talk.stephen.3.02.text: I only told him the truth. You were very close. You were right under the sound desk.
c7_gate.talk.stephen.3.02.synthesis_text: I only told him the truth. You were very close. You were right under the sound desk.
c7_gate.talk.stephen.3.02.previous_text: Rook’s copy wished you luck finding me.
c7_gate.talk.stephen.3.02.next_text: Please stop enjoying this so much.

c7_gate.truck.lead.01.speaker: steve
c7_gate.truck.lead.01.text: Inside the fence, I climbed out from under the sound desk, tripped over a cable and landed at the feet of the woman running the sound check.
c7_gate.truck.lead.01.synthesis_text: Inside the fence, I climbed out from under the sound desk, tripped over a cable and landed at the feet of the woman running the sound check.
c7_gate.truck.lead.01.previous_text: Pell put the letter into Ward’s own hand at the delegation hatch at 11:54 and came back with the yellow carbon. And a note for the record: left wrist, bandaged. A fresh ribbon burn.
c7_gate.truck.lead.01.next_text: Sound check. I’m supposed to be under the desk.

c7_swap.bus.lead.04.speaker: stephen
c7_swap.bus.lead.04.text: The press van feeds the national broadcast. Keep the tone off it, or every copy watching at home hears it too.
c7_swap.bus.lead.04.synthesis_text: The press van feeds the national broadcast. Keep the tone off it, or every copy watching at home hears it too.
c7_swap.bus.lead.04.previous_text: Blue reaches the lectern, the back fence and the service steps.
c7_swap.bus.lead.04.next_text: For June’s reply, three returns. Copper goes to you, Stephen and the lectern speaker.

c7_swap.recap.02.speaker: steve
c7_swap.recap.02.text: Iris told me later that the tone pulled at her too. She held on to June’s sleeve and counted Sunday dinners until it passed. Beside me, Stephen gripped the desk with both hands and did not turn.
c7_swap.recap.02.synthesis_text: Iris told me later that the tone pulled at her too. She held on to June’s sleeve and counted Sunday dinners until it passed. Beside me, Stephen gripped the desk with both hands and did not turn.
c7_swap.recap.02.previous_text: Fourteen copies turned toward the sea at once, in front of everyone who mattered. The real President was in a service tunnel, with a bandaged wrist and June Calder.
c7_swap.recap.02.next_text: Rook’s copy slipped away into the fog. Before he went, he asked me one thing.

c8_beach.second.find.speaker: steve
c8_beach.second.find.text: Saren’s message is Mom’s voicemail, cut and stitched: the same breath before ‘kiddo’, and a gap where ‘The bay is singing’ used to be. He has no message from her. He has my tape. Rook kept it for an hour at the safe house.
c8_beach.second.find.synthesis_text: Saren’s message is Mom’s voicemail, cut and stitched: the same breath before ‘kiddo’, and a gap where ‘The bay is singing’ used to be. He has no message from her. He has my tape. Rook kept it for an hour at the safe house.
c8_beach.second.find.previous_text: Same breath before ‘kiddo’. And a hole where four words used to be.
c8_beach.second.find.next_text: That’s my voicemail. You cut my mother out of her own message. No. You don’t get to trade the whole town for my family.

c8_rig.path.lead.04.speaker: stephen
c8_rig.path.lead.04.text: My crew pass still opens the antenna passage. I checked. Twice. Cancelling it would put Saren’s mistake on the record.
c8_rig.path.lead.04.synthesis_text: My crew pass still opens the antenna passage. I checked. Twice. Cancelling it would put Saren’s mistake on the record.
c8_rig.path.lead.04.previous_text: The fleet trusts nothing that its own ship did not measure.
c8_rig.path.lead.04.next_text: And the sleepers are in the Gallery. Mom and Dad are in row nine.

c9_choir.in.06.speaker: steve
c9_choir.in.06.text: The straps opened. The crew let go of Stephen. Even Saren stepped back from the console.
c9_choir.in.06.synthesis_text: The straps opened. The crew let go of Stephen. Even Saren stepped back from the console.
c9_choir.in.06.next_text: We followed you down from row nine. Nobody stopped us. The whole crew had stopped to listen.

c9_choir.in.07.speaker: calder
c9_choir.in.07.text: We followed you down from row nine. Nobody stopped us. The whole crew had stopped to listen.
c9_choir.in.07.synthesis_text: We followed you down from row nine. Nobody stopped us. The whole crew had stopped to listen.
c9_choir.in.07.direction: arriving with Helen, Frank and Nora, out of breath
c9_choir.in.07.previous_text: The straps opened. The crew let go of Stephen. Even Saren stepped back from the console.
c9_choir.in.07.next_text: Four thousand years of unchanged records. Three hundred and twelve human lives. Show us one record that changed, and we will choose.

epilogue.bait.find.speaker: steve
epilogue.bait.find.text: Two Mrs. Penhallows, one counter, and people are finally buying bait. One Adrian Rook stays. The other one is leaving town, to find out who he is.
epilogue.bait.find.synthesis_text: Two Mrs. Penhallows, one counter, and people are finally buying bait. One Adrian Rook stays. The other one is leaving town, to find out who he is.
epilogue.bait.find.previous_text: I’ll have to find out who that is.
epilogue.bait.find.next_text: Steve, we’re home. There is coffee. Your father has labeled the paint.

epilogue.talk.rook_copy.1.01.speaker: rook_copy
epilogue.talk.rook_copy.1.01.text: I’m leaving town today. I want to find out who I am when nobody is watching.
epilogue.talk.rook_copy.1.01.synthesis_text: I’m leaving town today. I want to find out who I am when nobody is watching.
epilogue.talk.rook_copy.1.01.previous_text: That’s what June said. Word for word.
epilogue.talk.rook_copy.1.01.next_text: Good luck out there. I mean it.
